AI Daily Memory records your day so you can recall decisions and promises later. Audio stays encrypted on this phone. You can pause or stop from the notification at any time.
While recording, a notification always shows that the microphone is on, with Pause and Stop. Recording never happens without it.
Android won\'t ask again. Open Settings, choose Permissions, and allow it there.
Notifications are turned off for this app, so the recording indicator and the \"tap to resume\" alert will not appear. Turn them on to see when recording is active.
The recording status notification is blocked. Allow it so you can always see when recording is active.
The recording status notification was set to silent, which can hide it from the status bar. Set it back to the default level so the indicator stays visible.
Recording may stop in the background
Many phones quietly shut down background apps to save battery. If that happens here, your day stops being recorded without a warning.

On Samsung phones: open Battery for this app and choose Unrestricted. Then go to Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, and make sure AI Daily Memory is not under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps. Turn off \"Put unused apps to sleep\" if it keeps coming back.
Fix: open battery settings, choose AI Daily Memory, and set it to Unrestricted or Don\'t optimize.

Turns your recordings into transcripts and a daily summary. With an account connected this happens on aidailymem.apercallc.com; offline, recordings wait on your phone.

Fill in the address and key for both services below. Recordings wait until then; nothing is lost.

Frees storage automatically once the transcript is saved. The transcript is kept so you can verify any summary.
Sends each day\'s summary and memory items to your account so you can read them on other devices. Never sends audio. Does nothing while you are offline.

To connect: 1) Choose Create account or Sign in. 2) Enter your email and password. 3) Tap the button. The app checks the connection and saves it, so there is no address or token to copy.
Connecting sends only the parts of your day where someone is talking, over an encrypted connection, to %1$s, the server you chose. Nothing else leaves your phone. Recording works without an account.

AI Daily Memory listens through the day, keeps only the parts where people are talking, and turns them into notes you can search. It always shows when it is recording, and you can pause or stop any time from your phone or your watch.
You can change this later in Settings.
Nothing leaves your phone. Recordings stay encrypted here. No account needed.
A free account on aidailymem.apercallc.com turns speech into transcripts, summaries and searchable memory.
When you first tap Start, Android asks for two things.

Microphone, to hear the conversation. Notifications, so the recording indicator is always visible. Some phones also close apps to save battery; if that happens, Today shows a card that takes you straight to the right setting.
Open the Today tab and tap Start. A paired watch can start, pause and stop the same recording; the phone\'s microphone does the listening, so only one device records at a time.
